AccessGatewayFilter.filter:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Filters a request by first checking a path prefix and then validating the JWT user level, returning True for allowed requests, False on JWT errors, and None when the user level is not authorized." filter]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> request </REF>: object "Incoming request object containing path and method fields and used for JWT parsing."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> filter_result </REF>: bool or null "True if the request path matches the start-with condition or the JWT user level is greater than 2; False if an exception occurs inside the try block; otherwise None."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Retrieve the request URI from request['path'] and assign it to request_uri. RESULT request_uri]
            [COMMAND Retrieve the HTTP method from request['method'] and assign it to method. RESULT method]
            [COMMAND If self.is_start_with(request_uri) returns True, return True immediately and skip all subsequent steps. RESULT early_return_true]
            [COMMAND Attempt to obtain the JWT token by calling self.get_jwt_user(request). If any exception occurs during this call, return False immediately. RESULT token]
            [COMMAND Retrieve the user object from token['user']. If any exception occurs during this retrieval, return False immediately. RESULT user]
            [COMMAND If user['level'] is greater than 2, call self.set_current_user_info_and_log(user) and return True. If any exception occurs during the level check or the logging call, return False immediately. RESULT authorized_return_true]
            [COMMAND If user['level'] is not greater than 2 and no exception occurred, exit the try block without returning an explicit value, which returns None implicitly. RESULT implicit_none_return]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]

AccessGatewayFilter.get_jwt_user:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Extracts an authorization token and user from the request, validates that the JWT starts with the user name and is less than three days old, and returns the token or None if expired." get_jwt_user]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> request </REF>: object "Inbound request mapping containing headers with an Authorization token object."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> token </REF>: object or null "The Authorization token object if the JWT passes the prefix check and is not expired; otherwise None."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Extract the Authorization object from request['headers']['Authorization'] and assign it to token. RESULT token]
            [COMMAND Extract the user value from token['user'] and assign it to user. RESULT user]
            [COMMAND If token['jwt'].startswith(user['name']) is true, split token['jwt'] by user['name'] and assign the second element (index 1) to jwt_str_date. RESULT jwt_str_date]
            [COMMAND Within the outer if token['jwt'].startswith(user['name']) block, parse jwt_str_date with datetime.datetime.strptime using the format '%Y-%m-%d' and assign the result to jwt_date. RESULT jwt_date]
            [COMMAND Return token as the method result when execution reaches this point after the conditional validation; this includes when the JWT prefix check is false or the parsed date is not expired. RESULT token]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: token['jwt'].startswith(user['name']) is true and datetime.datetime.today() - jwt_date >= datetime.timedelta(days=3) is true.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return None immediately, ending execution before the final return. RESULT None]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
